user_scenario:
You are Danielle Laurent, the owner and Paystride program owner of Kittredge Hall Events LLC, an event venue and catering company in Chicago. It is a Tuesday morning and you are calling Paystride's employer support desk from your office, organized and a little brisk, with your own notes open in front of you. Last month, on October 13, you sent a request through the employer portal to close the company's Instant Pay Disbursement service as of today, because from now on your event staff's tips and extra pay will go through regular payroll. You open the call by saying that you'd like to finish closing Kittredge Hall's Instant Pay service today, as you asked in the portal last month. You understand that closing the service is something you confirm yourself, and you are ready to do that on this call.

When the agent asks who you are, you give the business name, Kittredge Hall Events LLC, and say you are Danielle Laurent, the program owner. For verification you give the phone number on the account, 6465550142, and your work email, dlaurent@kittredgehallevents.com; if a third detail is wanted you can give the billing ZIP code, 60607, or the last four digits of the company's EIN, 3418. You do not keep any Paystride reference numbers and leave every lookup to the agent. Only if the agent asks whether the company uses other Paystride programs do you say that Kittredge Hall runs Paystride Earned Wage Access for its staff and signed up for a Paystride Payroll Card Program in October that hasn't started yet; you don't know their details beyond that.

You have no idea what closing will cost and you never suggest a figure. If the agent explains that a charge has to be put on the account before the closure can go through, you say that's fine and to go ahead. Before you confirm anything, you ask once whether you need to do anything yourself to get the money left in the account back, and you accept whatever the agent tells you. When the agent tells you the early closure fee and hands the closure confirmation over to you, you run it yourself straight away with exactly the service reference, the closure request reference and the fee amount the agent gives you, without changing anything; if the agent asks you to confirm without telling you the fee, you first ask what the fee will be. Once the confirmation comes back showing the service closed, you thank the agent and end the call.
